#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    int total = n + m;

    vector<long long> fact(total + 1), invFact(total + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= total; i++) {
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }
    invFact[total] = modpow(fact[total], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = total; i >= 1; i--) {
        invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % MOD;
    }

    auto ncr = [&](int n, int r) -> long long {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return fact[n] * invFact[r] % MOD * invFact[n - r] % MOD;
    };

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long cur = 1;
    for (int i = 0; cur != 0; i++) {
        cur = cur * (n - i) % MOD * modpow(n + m - i, MOD - 2) % MOD;
        phaseSize = (phaseSize + cur) % MOD;
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long term = ncr(n, k);
        term = term * (m + k) % MOD;
        term = term * modpow(k, MOD - 2) % MOD;
        term = term * phaseSize % MOD;
        if (k & 1) {
            answer = (answer + term) % MOD;
        } else {
            answer = (answer - term + MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";
    return 0;
}
